name: Kross Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1991, Kross Ltd manufactures 
high performance and safety critical components for the commercial vehicle, tractor and trailer axle industry[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
KL manufactures trailer axles & suspension assemblies and safety critical components for the M&HCV and farm equipment segments

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 86.3% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Debtor days have increased from 70.1 to 107 days.
Working capital days have increased from 51.9 days to 106 days
